visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair in a bun and a white short-sleeved polo shirt stands beside a massage bed. A person lies face down under a thick grey blanket. The woman gestures with her hands and speaks with an animated facial expression. (2) The woman begins massaging the person's back through the blanket using her palms. She maintains a rhythmic motion while looking down at the client and talking. The background is a plain, neutral-colored wall in a brightly lit indoor setting. (3) The woman picks up the client's hand to examine the palm. She points at specific lines on the palm with her finger, leaning in closely with a curious and then smiling expression. A white smartwatch is visible on the client's wrist. (4) Moving to the foot of the bed, the woman holds the client's bare foot and presses her thumbs into the sole. She looks off-camera while speaking, her eyebrows raised in a playful or suggestive manner. (5) The client is now sitting up, wearing a black t-shirt, with their back to the camera. The woman stands behind them, kneading their shoulders. She looks to the side as if sharing a secret, her mouth moving quickly. (6) The woman uses both open palms to strike the client's upper back in a rapid, rhythmic patting motion. She concludes the action, turns to a white plastic trolley, and smiles as she pushes it out of the frame.
